# Sebastian Raschka, PhD

> A comprehensive resource for LLM research, education, and architecture analysis by Sebastian Raschka, covering books, courses, technical analysis, and cutting-edge AI developments.

Sebastian Raschka is an LLM Research Engineer and author who publishes in-depth technical content on machine learning, large language models, and AI research. The site serves as a hub for his educational materials, books, newsletter, and analysis of emerging LLM architectures and techniques.

## Key Topics

- Large Language Models (LLMs)
- LLM Architecture
- Machine Learning
- Deep Learning
- PyTorch
- Reasoning Models
- Inference-Time Scaling
- Open-Weight Models
- Model Comparison
- AI Research
- Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch)
- DeepSeek
- RLVR
- LLM Architecture Gallery
- Technical Analysis

## Core Resources

- [Homepage](https://sebastianraschka.com): Homepage showcasing Sebastian Raschka's AI/LLM research, books, talks, and projects
- [Books](https://sebastianraschka.com/books): Overview of Raschka's published books on ML, deep learning, and LLMs with purchase links
- [Courses](https://sebastianraschka.com/teaching): Course materials and video resources on ML, deep learning, PyTorch, and LLM training

## LLM Architecture & Technical Analysis

- [LLM Architecture Gallery](https://sebastianraschka.com/llm-architecture-gallery): Gallery of LLM architecture figures with fact sheets and links to detailed comparisons
- [New LLM Architecture Gallery](https://sebastianraschka.com/blog/2026/llm-architecture-gallery.html): Blog post introducing the LLM Architecture Gallery with comparison figures and fact sheets
- [A Dream of Spring for Open-Weight LLMs: 10 Architectures from Jan-Feb 2026](https://magazine.sebastianraschka.com/p/a-dream-of-spring-for-open-weight): Analysis and comparison of 10 open-weight LLM releases from early 2026
- [Categories of Inference-Time Scaling for Improved LLM Reasoning](https://magazine.sebastianraschka.com/p/categories-of-inference-time-scaling): Overview of inference-time scaling techniques and recent papers on LLM reasoning

## Blog & Newsletter

- [Blog and Notes](https://sebastianraschka.com/blog): Archive of Raschka's blog posts on LLMs, AI research, PyTorch, and machine learning
- [Subscribe to Ahead of AI](https://magazine.sebastianraschka.com/subscribe): Subscription page for Ahead of AI newsletter on machine learning and AI research
- [The State Of LLMs 2025: Progress, Progress, and Predictions](https://magazine.sebastianraschka.com/p/state-of-llms-2025): 2025 review of LLM progress including DeepSeek, architectures, and 2026 predictions

## Talks & Media

- [Talks and Events](https://sebastianraschka.com/elsewhere): Raschka's talks, panels, podcasts, and conference appearances on AI and LLMs
- [State of AI 2026 with Sebastian Raschka, Nathan Lambert, and Lex Fridman](https://sebastianraschka.com/blog/2026/state-of-ai-interview.html): 4.5-hour interview on current state of AI progress with Lex Fridman and Nathan Lambert
